hard_guards: compiled quality below online quality => ONLINE regardless of expected read count
unknown/short lifetime below guarded break-even => ONLINE
architecture_consequence: Materialization is no longer an unconditional optimization. V14/U15 semantic fields should be compiled only when measured per-query savings, non-regressed quality, build cost and expected reads before epoch invalidation predict positive guarded total-work savings. Otherwise route to the already-valid online/index path.
limitations: Expected reads-before-invalidation can be forecast incorrectly and must be updated from live Pulse telemetry.
Build/update cost may change with scale, WAL pressure, hardware and graph churn.
Current break-even numbers are fixture-specific, not universal constants.
